clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around Teodor's death in January 1978, within the following months: Delphine stopped cooking and went to her mother Odette's every evening; Duncan took night shifts away from Odette; Anton began drinking at lunch with a warning at work; Celeste separated from Anton in August; Odette lay awake over her mother and Anton; and Callum developed ear infections through the winter. Delphine's functioning began to recover when she took a job at the library in May 1979.

clusters.name: Odette's pregnancy bedrest, 1984
clusters.reason: Around Odette being ordered to bed for the rest of her pregnancy in March 1984, within the following months: Hazel came every morning to keep the house and overfunctioned; Duncan argued with his mother over how she kept it; and Callum stammered again after a year free of it. These shifts show the family's reactions in those months; no one else's shifts show then.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1996
clusters.reason: Hazel was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in September 1986. Within the following decade: Ambrose took over her cooking and appointments; Duncan phoned his father every night for news of her; Duncan and Lyle argued over who should help their parents; Duncan's drinking rose to most evenings; and Duncan and Odette fought over his evenings at his parents' house. The period reaches to when Hazel moved to the nursing home in June 1997, where the family's reactions around her care settled into a new arrangement.

clusters.name: Callum leaving for the mines, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around Callum leaving home for a job at the mines up north in May 1999, within the surrounding months: Duncan and Callum argued most nights over his plans to go north; Odette could not settle at the thought of him so far away; Duncan missed days at work and sat up late in the garage; Ines skipped school most of that autumn; Odette took Ines with her everywhere; and by August 2000 Ines was back at school full days and passed her exams. The family settled as Ines's functioning recovered.
